rationale: The telemetry indicates that the robot experienced 5 line loss events during the last trial, which is still high. To address this, I am adjusting the controller parameters to improve performance. I have set the base speed to 0.05, kp to 0.8, ki to 0.1, kd to 0.05, and adjusted the sensor weights to [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]. These changes are expected to enhance the robot's line-following capabilities and reduce line loss events. I anticipate that these adjustments will lead to better tracking and overall performance in the next race.
